raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On gfx950, aiter MLA decode runs RoPE, the q/k concat and the KV-cache write in one `fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` kernel. On gfx1250 these are still separate: native RoPE, two `torch.cat` and `set_kv_buffer`, more than a dozen elementwise kernels per layer. This PR extends the gfx950 fused branch to gfx1250.

## Modifications

With `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` on gfx1250, MLA decode with the aiter or triton backend skips the standalone RoPE and takes the fused branch, as aiter MLA does on gfx950. gfx950 is unchanged.

- As on gfx950, the gate is evaluated per call: decode, the aiter or triton backend, no DSA, one DCP rank, a rope module of exactly `RotaryEmbedding` or `DeepseekScalingRotaryEmbedding`, and a bf16 or FP8 KV pool. The pool check reads the pool's dtype, so an fp16 pool, which the kernel rejects, stays on the unfused path.
- sglang's rope keeps cos and sin in one `cos_sin_cache`; the kernel gets the two halves as strided views.
- Q keeps `q_nope_out`'s dtype, which is bf16 on gfx1250: MLA decode there takes an unquantized Q even over an FP8 KV cache.
- Prepare's rope-skip condition moves into `_applies_rope_in_prepare`, so the unit test can check that prepare skips RoPE exactly when core fuses it.
- CPU unit tests are added to `test/registered/unit/models/test_rocm_mla_absorb_fusion_gate.py`.

Requires ROCm/aiter#5501, which both ROCm Docker pins in `docker/rocm.Dockerfile` already contain. On main, gfx1250 MLA decode runs the triton backend, which the gate covers, and the first set of numbers below is main with the triton decode backend. With #44458's aiter decode backend the same fused branch applies; the second table measures that.

Validated on gfx1250 with Kimi-K2-Thinking-MXFP4 at TP8, with the triton decode backend on main and the aiter decode backend from #44458.

## Accuracy Tests

The fused kernel matches the unfused path (q and the written KV rows) for bf16 and FP8 KV, batch 1 to 128.

GSM8K, 8-shot, 1319 questions, triton decode backend on main:

| | KV cache | Runs | Accuracy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Before | FP8 | 4 | 0.942 (0.950, 0.939, 0.939, 0.939) |
| After | FP8 | 4 | 0.940 (0.942, 0.938, 0.934, 0.945) |
| Before | bf16 | 1 | 0.947 |
| After | bf16 | 1 | 0.938 |

Unchanged main moves by 0.011 between server launches (0.950 and 0.939), so the single bf16 run is within that spread.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

RoPE, concat and KV write per layer, Kimi-K2 TP8 shapes, CUDA graph replay:

| batch | unfused (us) | fused (us) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 37.6 | 1.9 |
| 4 | 40.8 | 1.6 |
| 32 | 55.6 | 1.7 |
| 128 | 81.6 | 1.9 |

`bench_serving`, 8k input / 1k output, FP8 KV, triton decode backend on main:

| Concurrency | | Throughput per GPU (tok/s/GPU) | Interactivity (tok/s/user) | Median TTFT (ms) | Median TPOT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | Before | 171.4 | 39.7 | 416.8 | 25.20 |
| 4 | After | 217.7 | 51.2 | 406.4 | 19.54 |
| 4 | Change | +27.0% | +29.0% | -2.5% | -22.5% |
| 16 | Before | 398.8 | 22.9 | 440.6 | 43.63 |
| 16 | After | 483.4 | 28.0 | 427.1 | 35.68 |
| 16 | Change | +21.2% | +22.3% | -3.1% | -18.2% |
| 64 | Before | 647.9 | 9.4 | 677.0 | 106.87 |
| 64 | After | 745.6 | 10.7 | 518.1 | 93.66 |
| 64 | Change | +15.1% | +14.1% | -23.5% | -12.4% |

In the decode profile (concurrency 4, 8k context), each layer's RoPE, concat and KV write go from about 14 PyTorch kernels taking about 82 us to the fused kernel taking about 3 us, and the decode step goes from 30.0 ms to 23.6 ms. The triton decode attention kernels are unchanged.

Concurrency 4 with #44458's aiter decode backend on both sides:

| | Throughput per GPU (tok/s/GPU) | Interactivity (tok/s/user) | Median TTFT (ms) | Median TPOT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Before | 304.7 | 71.4 | 271.3 | 14.00 |
| After | 443.1 | 104.9 | 262.6 | 9.53 |
| Change | +45.4% | +46.9% | -3.2% | -31.9% |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No user-facing option changes.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -34,6 +34,10 @@
     view_aiter_fused_rms_transposed_fp8_scale_tuple,
 )

 from sglang.srt.lora.deepseek_mla_correction import (
     apply_q_correction as apply_kv_b_lora_q_correction,
 )
@@ -153,6 +157,15 @@ def fused_qk_rmsnorm_bf16(q, q_weight, q_eps, k, k_weight, k_eps):
         fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla,
     )
 
+# The gfx1250 launch of this kernel needs aiter with ROCm/aiter#5501.
+_use_gfx1250_fused_mla_rope = _use_aiter and _is_gfx1250_supported
+if _use_gfx1250_fused_mla_rope:
+    from aiter.ops.triton.fusions.fused_kv_cache import (
+        fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla,
+    )
+
+_GFX1250_FUSED_ROPE_BACKENDS = ("aiter", "triton")
+
 
 _ABSORB_BMM_DECODE_MAX_M = 256
 _absorb_bmm_num_cu = 0
@@ -435,18 +448,29 @@ def _fused_rope_cat_and_cache(
     positions: torch.Tensor,
     out_cache_loc: torch.Tensor,
 ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
-    """RoPE + concat + KV-cache write via the AITER fused kernel on gfx95."""
+    """RoPE + concat + KV-cache write via the AITER fused kernel on gfx95 or gfx1250."""
     kv_cache_dtype = (
         fp8_dtype if attn.kv_cache_dtype == "fp8_e4m3" else q_nope_out.dtype
     )
     # Gluon MLA decode (bh16bn128) requires bf16 Q; vLLM #50563.
+    # gfx1250 MLA decode (aiter ASM, paged Gluon, triton) takes an unquantized Q;
+    # q_nope_out is bf16 there, since rocm_absorb_q_bmm computes in bf16.
     q_out_dtype = (
         q_nope_out.dtype
-        if attn.kv_cache_dtype == "fp8_e4m3"
-        and attn.current_attention_backend == "aiter"
-        and q_nope_out.shape[-2] == 12
+        if (
+            attn.kv_cache_dtype == "fp8_e4m3"
+            and attn.current_attention_backend == "aiter"
+            and q_nope_out.shape[-2] == 12
+        )
+        or _use_gfx1250_fused_mla_rope
         else kv_cache_dtype
     )
+    if _use_gfx1250_fused_mla_rope:
+        # sglang's rope keeps [cos | sin] in one cache; the kernel takes strided
+        # cos/sin, so the two halves go in as views.
+        cos, sin = attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+    else:
+        cos, sin = attn.rotary_emb.cos_cache, attn.rotary_emb.sin_cache
     kv_pool = get_token_to_kv_pool()
     if isinstance(kv_pool, HiSparseDSATokenToKVPool):
         # The fused write bypasses set_mla_kv_buffer()'s logical-to-device mapping.
@@ -461,8 +485,8 @@ def _fused_rope_cat_and_cache(
         kv_pool.layer_router.read(attn.attn_mqa.layer_id).key(),
         out_cache_loc,
         positions,
-        attn.rotary_emb.cos_cache,
-        attn.rotary_emb.sin_cache,
+        cos,
+        sin,
         attn.attn_mqa.k_scale,
         attn.rotary_emb.is_neox_style,
         q_out_dtype=q_out_dtype,
@@ -794,37 +818,7 @@ def forward_absorb_rocm_prepare(
                 elif is_kv_b_lora_active(self):
                     q_nope_out = apply_kv_b_lora_q_correction(self, q_nope, q_nope_out)
 
-        fuse_rope_for_trtllm_mla = self._fuse_rope_for_trtllm_mla(forward_batch)
-
-        force_rope_for_aiter_dcp_decode = (
-            self.dcp_size > 1
-            and (
-                forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
-                or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
-                or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
-            )
-            and _use_aiter_gfx95
-            and self.current_attention_backend
-            not in FORWARD_ABSORB_CORE_ATTENTION_BACKENDS
-        )
-        if self.rotary_emb is not None and (
-            force_rope_for_aiter_dcp_decode
-            or (
-                (not fuse_rope_for_trtllm_mla)
-                and (not self._skip_rope_for_dsa_tilelang_fused())
-                and (not self._skip_rope_for_aiter_fused_mla())
-                and (
-                    not _use_aiter
-                    or not _is_gfx95_supported
-                    or self.use_dsa
-                    or (
-                        self.current_attention_backend
-                        not in FORWARD_ABSORB_CORE_ATTENTION_BACKENDS
-                        and self.current_attention_backend != "aiter"
-                    )
-                )
-            )
-        ):
+        if self._applies_rope_in_prepare(forward_batch):
             q_pe, k_pe = self.rotary_emb(positions, q_pe, k_pe)
 
         # all_gather q_pe, q_nope_out,take tp8 as an example， q_pe [B, H, ROPE_DIM], q_nope_out [B, H, NOPE_DIM] gathered to [B, H * dcp_world_size, ROPE_DIM] [B, H * dcp_world_size, NOPE_DIM] for decode batch, and all gather k_pe, k_nope for extend batch.
@@ -872,6 +866,41 @@ def forward_absorb_rocm_prepare(
             q_nope if fuse_bmm_rope_cache else None,
         )
 
+    def _applies_rope_in_prepare(
+        self: DeepseekV2AttentionMLA, forward_batch: ForwardBatch
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Whether prepare applies rope; otherwise core or the backend fuses it."""
+        force_rope_for_aiter_dcp_decode = (
+            self.dcp_size > 1
+            and (
+                forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+                or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+                or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+            )
+            and _use_aiter_gfx95
+            and self.current_attention_backend
+            not in FORWARD_ABSORB_CORE_ATTENTION_BACKENDS
+        )
+        return self.rotary_emb is not None and (
+            force_rope_for_aiter_dcp_decode
+            or (
+                (not self._fuse_rope_for_trtllm_mla(forward_batch))
+                and (not self._skip_rope_for_dsa_tilelang_fused())
+                and (not self._skip_rope_for_aiter_fused_mla())
+                and (not self._fuse_rope_for_gfx1250_mla(forward_batch))
+                and (
+                    not _use_aiter
+                    or not _is_gfx95_supported
+                    or self.use_dsa
+                    or (
+                        self.current_attention_backend
+                        not in FORWARD_ABSORB_CORE_ATTENTION_BACKENDS
+                        and self.current_attention_backend != "aiter"
+                    )
+                )
+            )
+        )
+
     def forward_absorb_rocm_core(
         self: DeepseekV2AttentionMLA,
         q_pe,
@@ -1032,7 +1061,9 @@ def forward_absorb_rocm_core(
                 **(dict(topk_indices=topk_indices) if topk_indices is not None else {}),
             )
         else:
-            if self._skip_rope_for_aiter_fused_mla():
+            if self._skip_rope_for_aiter_fused_mla() or self._fuse_rope_for_gfx1250_mla(
+                forward_batch
+            ):
                 q, _, _, k = _fused_rope_cat_and_cache(
                     self,
                     q_nope_out,
@@ -1228,6 +1259,25 @@ def _skip_rope_for_dsa_tilelang_fused(self: DeepseekV2AttentionMLA) -> bool:
             )
         )
 
+    def _fuse_rope_for_gfx1250_mla(
+        self: DeepseekV2AttentionMLA, forward_batch: ForwardBatch
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Skip rope in prepare and fuse it with the KV-cache write in core on gfx1250."""
+        # The platform term goes first: other platforms never look up the KV pool.
+        return (
+            _use_gfx1250_fused_mla_rope
+            and forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+            and self.current_attention_backend in _GFX1250_FUSED_ROPE_BACKENDS
+            and not self.use_dsa
+            and self.dcp_size == 1
+            # The kernel applies a plain rope from its cos_sin_cache; subclasses such
+            # as Bailing's video mrope compute theirs differently.
+            and type(self.rotary_emb)
+            in (RotaryEmbedding, DeepseekScalingRotaryEmbedding)
+            # The kernel accepts only a bf16 or fp8 pool.
+            and get_token_to_kv_pool().dtype in (torch.bfloat16, fp8_dtype)
+        )
+
     def _skip_rope_for_aiter_fused_mla(self: DeepseekV2AttentionMLA) -> bool:

+_ROPE_HEAD_DIM = 64
+_LAYER_ID = 3
+_FP8 = forward_mla_rocm.fp8_dtype
+_SENTINEL = 7.0

+
+class _CoreDone(Exception):

+
+class _Mqa:
+    """attn_mqa stand-in that stops core once the rope / KV-write choice is made."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.layer_id = _LAYER_ID
+        self.k_scale = torch.tensor(0.5)
+        self.save_kv_cache = None
+
+    def __call__(self, q, k, v, forward_batch, *, save_kv_cache):

+def _rope(rope_cls=RotaryEmbedding, **kwargs):
+    with mock.patch("sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding.base._is_cpu", True):
+        return rope_cls(
+            head_size=_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+            rotary_dim=_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+            max_position_embeddings=32,
+            base=10000,
+            is_neox_style=False,
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            **kwargs,
+        )

+class _RocmAttn(forward_mla_rocm.DeepseekMLARocmForwardMixin):
+    """An attention module every gfx1250 term accepts, before a case breaks one."""
+
+    def __init__(self, **overrides):
+        self.current_attention_backend = "aiter"
+        self.kv_cache_dtype = "auto"
+        self.use_dsa = False
+        self.dcp_size = 1
+        self.rotary_emb = _rope()

+def _pool(key):

+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        dtype=key.dtype, layer_router=SimpleNamespace(read=layers.__getitem__)
+    )

+    return SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=mode, **fields)

+        self.use_pool(SimpleNamespace(dtype=torch.bfloat16))

+    def patch_attr(self, target, name, value):
+        patcher = mock.patch.object(target, name, value, create=True)
+        patcher.start()
+        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)

+    def use_pool(self, key):

+class TestGfx1250FusedRopeGate(_Gfx1250Case):
+    def test_takes_the_fused_path_when_every_term_holds(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self.fuses(_RocmAttn()))

+    def test_only_decode_fuses(self):

+    def test_triton_decode(self):

+
+    def test_each_term_alone_turns_it_off(self):

+        # indexer layout and no DCP-sharded KV.
